core_categories: Pharmaceuticals; OTC Healthcare; Dermocosmetics; Nutrition and Supplements; Medical Devices; Optical Products
specialty_focus: Droguería Colsubsidio is a major retail pharmacy chain in Colombia, operated by the Colsubsidio family compensation fund. It serves general shoppers and system members, offering prescription drugs, OTC medicine, dermocosmetics, nutrition, and specialized health products including medical devices and orthopedic support. Its specialty focus includes holistic wellness through specialized store formats like Droguería Vital, professional guidance via on-site consultations and vision screening, and ecosystem integration with exclusive discounts and digital tools for Colsubsidio members.
key_brands: Famisanar, Sura, Salud Bolívar, Rappi, others
